value.signature: fn fmt (& self , formatter : & mut std :: fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> std :: fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Location key formatting borrows an already published diagnostic.

review.body: { let mut list = formatter . debug_list () ; for at in 0 .. usize :: from (self . 0 . used) { match self . 0 . kinds [at] { LocationKind :: Text => { list . entry (& self . 0 . key_text (at) . ok_or (std :: fmt :: Error) ?) ; } LocationKind :: Bytes => { list . entry (& self . 0 . key_bytes (at) . ok_or (std :: fmt :: Error) ?) ; } LocationKind :: Integer => { list . entry (& self . 0 . key_integer (at) . ok_or (std :: fmt :: Error) ?) ; } LocationKind :: Null => { list . entry (& "null") ; } LocationKind :: Empty => { } } } list . finish () }
review.item_premise: The published audit location exposes only its fixed tag and already retained scalar key; inspection does not read or allocate store state.
